episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the transformative role of AI in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing its use as a tool to enhance rather than replace the realtor's expertise. She shares insights on leveraging local knowledge and AI to build trust with clients, even remotely, and offers strategies for targeting high-net-worth buyers effectively.
